title: Triune Goddess of the Veil
description: A three-faced female figure with long white hair stands at the center of a cracked stone pathway, wearing a black and purple patterned cloak with dripping details. She holds a swirling red and purple orb containing a silhouetted person, set against a dark surreal landscape with a large red moon, floating geometric shapes, glowing skeletal figures, volcanic mountains with red lava, and starry cosmic elements.
prompt: A three-faced goddess with long flowing white hair and black eyes stands centered on a broken stone path, wearing a dark cloak decorated with purple triangles and dripping motifs. She holds a circular portal showing a red spiral vortex with a lone silhouetted figure inside. Behind her is a giant cracked triangular monolith filled with glowing purple skeletal figures and a multi-eyed demon. The background features jagged black mountains with flowing red lava, a large blood-red moon containing smaller triangles and figures, floating geometric shapes, purple stars, and cosmic swirls on a pitch black background.
